proposedOverrides.name: Beylik of Aydın (Aydınid dynasty)
proposedOverrides.summary: Western Anatolian beylik ruled by the Aydınid dynasty from about 1308, interrupted by Ottoman occupation, restored after 1402, and finally conquered in 1426.
